scenes.subject: Dusk lake from behind the narrator, chest-deep, the lit dry boat far out

layers.midground: black water with a thin lantern streak and no wake
layers.background: dark ridge on the right, last orange sliver at the horizon

scenes.light_source: lantern and cabin window on the boat, a faint cold moon

layers.midground: ripple rings spreading from him in time with his breath
layers.background: the boat a little closer, still lit

scenes.light_source: boat lantern, moon glow on steam
scenes.motion: ripple rings pulse with his slowed breathing
scenes.camera: push-in, slight tilt down to the waterline
details: goosebump rim light on his neck

scenes.subject: He turns: the shore behind him and the post where he stood calling

layers.midground: the empty mud bank with his three nights of footprints
layers.background: the village lights far up the hill, none near

scenes.light_source: a single lamp on the post, village glow

scenes.camera: slow turn from the water back toward the bank, then back to the boat

scenes.withheld: who is standing in the dark by the post

layers.foreground: warm steam rising off black water in the lantern light
layers.midground: the boat hull ringed by drifting mist
layers.background: ridge and stars above the glow

scenes.light_source: lantern glow turning amber into the steam, moon above
scenes.motion: steam coils upward, the water surface slides, ripples slow and stop shivering him
scenes.camera: low glide forward, slight upward tilt through the steam
details: amber tint creeping into the water

layers.foreground: fogged window panes with faint pale smears forming
layers.midground: the cabin wall and the lantern at its right
layers.background: the black water and the ridge

scenes.light_source: window glow pulsing in time with the murmur, lantern warm

scenes.camera: slow push toward the window, small lateral drift

pulse of light on the water

scenes.subject: The red jacket on the bow seat, warm to the touch

layers.foreground: his hand reaching into frame, his fingers trembling
layers.midground: the red jacket breathing slightly on the seat
layers.background: the bow rising out of the steam

scenes.light_source: lantern light warm on the red cloth
scenes.motion: the jacket rises and falls like breathing, steam off the wool
scenes.camera: push-in to the jacket, slight handheld wobble
details: red jacket on the bow seat

scenes.subject: His hand holding the sleeve, tears, the light steady

layers.foreground: the sleeve gripped in his fist
layers.midground: the jacket pressed to him, his bent head
layers.background: the lit boat steady and calm behind

scenes.light_source: steady warm lantern, moon on wet skin
scenes.motion: a slow steady sway of the boat, his shoulders shaking once
scenes.sound_cue: quiet bed, one sob, then nothing

scenes.subject: The cabin window brightens as the voice speaks, ripples answer it

layers.foreground: the black water ringing with each syllable
layers.midground: the cabin window pulsing in the rhythm of a voice
layers.background: the bow, the jacket, the dark behind

scenes.light_source: the cabin window brightens with each word
scenes.motion: ripples ring out from under the boat in time with the voice
scenes.camera: slow push-in toward the window, nothing else moves

details: window panes brightening one by one

scenes.subject: His breath leaves him on one word

layers.foreground: a burst of steam from his mouth
layers.midground: his head turned toward the window, rim lit
layers.background: the window and the dark boat

scenes.light_source: window light at its brightest then cut off
scenes.motion: steam bursts, the head turns, the window flares then dies on the scare
scenes.camera: tight push-in on his head and the window
scenes.sound_cue: the reflex answer, silence, the lights-out stinger

scenes.subject: Black water, the lights gone, a ring closing around his chest

layers.foreground: the water line closing at his shoulders
layers.background: pitch dark with a thin moon line

scenes.light_source: moonlight only, a pale rim on the water
scenes.motion: rings contract around him, pulling inward, a single flicker of the lantern

scenes.subject: A small wet hand slaps against his back and shoves him

layers.foreground: a small wet handprint appearing on his back
layers.midground: his body thrown forward toward the bank

scenes.motion: the whole frame lurches shoreward, water streaming off him
